notes.title: UPDATES: New secret ending, balance changes and gratitude
notes.notes:
Moi!

Thank you everyone for playing Finnish Cottage 8 - our very first game. It has been incredible to see the positive feedback, and watch your playthroughs online. 

We've been listening to you and seeing what we can do better, and with that we are rolling out our first major update.

The What:
New Secret Ending... hyvät löylyt
Balance changes to make sure you get to experience more fun anomalies
Small tweaks and bug fixes

Once again, thank you all for playing our game and hope you have fun getting the secret ending 😉

Cheers,
Savukivi team

notes.title: Post-Launch Patch
notes.notes:
We've added two accessibility features: volume control for the radio broadcast and a visual effects slider for those who need better visual clarity in the dark cottage. We've also adjusted game balance slightly as there was a bug that made the final anomaly for some players too easy leading to unsatisfying victory.
Minor bug-fixes and improvements.
